translations.idiomatic: This divine merit and sage transformation—all that ancient sage rulers could not reach—Your Majesty personally performs—it truly shines across a thousand ages.

sentences.zh: 是則天地神祇，必報陛下以山嶽之壽；

translations.literal: Then heaven and earth and the spirits must repay Your Majesty with the longevity of mountains and rivers;
translations.idiomatic: In that case heaven and earth and the spirits must repay Your Majesty with the longevity of mountains and rivers;

sentences.zh: 宗廟聖靈，必福陛下以億萬之齡；

translations.literal: the ancestral spirits must bless Your Majesty with tens of millions of years;
translations.idiomatic: the ancestral spirits must bless Your Majesty with life beyond counting;

sentences.zh: 四海蒼生，鹹祈陛下以覆載之永。

translations.literal: the black-haired people all pray Your Majesty for covering and bearing without end.
translations.idiomatic: the black-haired people all pray that Your Majesty's covering and bearing may never end.

sentences.zh: 自然萬靈保祐，聖壽無疆。

translations.literal: Naturally the myriad spirits will protect and sacred life be without limit.
translations.idiomatic: In nature the myriad spirits will protect and sacred life be without limit.

sentences.zh: 伏見自去年已來，諸處頻薦藥術之士，有韋山甫、柳泌等，或更相稱引，迄今狂謬，薦送漸多。

translations.literal: I see that since last year places have repeatedly recommended men of elixir arts—Wei Shanfu, Liu Bi, and others—some praising one another; to this day the madness grows and recommendations increase.
translations.idiomatic: I see that since last year places have repeatedly recommended men of elixir arts—Wei Shanfu, Liu Bi, and others—some praising one another—to this day the madness grows and recommendations increase.

sentences.zh: 臣伏以真仙有道之士，皆匿其名姓，無求於代，潛遁山林，滅影雲壑，唯恐人見，唯懼人聞。

translations.literal: I submit that true immortals and men of the Way all hide their names, seek nothing from the age, vanish into mountains and forests, erase their shadows in cloud valleys, dreading only that people see, fearing only that people hear.
translations.idiomatic: I submit that true immortals and men of the Way all hide their names, seek nothing from the age, vanish into mountains and forests, erase their shadows in cloud valleys, dreading only that people see—fearing only that people hear.

sentences.zh: 豈肯幹謁公卿，自鬻其術？

translations.literal: How would they solicit grandees and peddle their arts?
translations.idiomatic: How would they solicit grandees and hawk their arts?

sentences.zh: 今者所有誇炫藥術者，必非知道之士。

translations.literal: Those who now boast elixir arts cannot be men who know the Way.
translations.idiomatic: Such who now boast elixir arts cannot be men who know the Way.

sentences.zh: 鹹為求利而來，自言飛煉為神，以誘權貴賄賂。

translations.literal: All come seeking profit, claiming transmutation makes gods, to lure the powerful and noble with bribes.
translations.idiomatic: All come seeking profit, claiming transmutation makes gods—to lure the powerful and noble with bribes.

sentences.zh: 大言怪論，驚聽惑時，及其假偽敗露，曾不恥於逃遁。

translations.literal: Grand strange talk startles hearing and confuses the age; when fraud is exposed they are not ashamed to flee.
translations.idiomatic: Grand strange talk startles hearing and confuses the age—when fraud is exposed they are not ashamed to flee.

sentences.zh: 如此情狀，豈可保信其術，親餌其藥哉？

translations.literal: Such conduct—how can one trust their arts and personally take their medicine?
translations.idiomatic: Conduct such as this—how can one trust their arts and personally swallow their medicine?

sentences.zh: 《禮》曰：「夫人，食味別聲，被色而生者也。」

translations.literal: The Rites says: "Man is one who lives by distinguishing flavors, sounds, and colors."
translations.idiomatic: The Rites says: "Man is one who lives by distinguishing flavors, sounds—and colors."

sentences.zh: 《春秋左氏傳》曰：「味以行氣，氣以實誌。」

translations.literal: The Zuo Commentary to the Spring and Autumn says: "Flavor moves qi; qi fills the will."
translations.idiomatic: The Zuo Commentary to the Spring and Autumn says: "Flavor moves qi—qi fills the will."

sentences.zh: 又曰：「水火醯醢鹽梅，以烹魚肉。

translations.literal: It also says: "Water, fire, vinegar, pickle, salt, and plum cook fish and flesh.
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "Water, fire, vinegar, pickle, salt—and plum cook fish and flesh.

sentences.zh: 宰夫和之，齊之以味；

translations.literal: The cook harmonizes them and balances with flavor;
translations.idiomatic: The cook harmonizes them and balances them with flavor;

sentences.zh: 君子食之，以平其心。」

translations.literal: the gentleman eats them to settle his heart."
translations.idiomatic: the gentleman eats them to settle his mind."

sentences.zh: 夫三牲五谷，稟自五行，發為五味，蓋天地生之所以奉人也，是以聖人節而食之，以致康強逢吉之福。

translations.literal: The three sacrificial beasts and five grains issue from the five phases and become five flavors—heaven and earth's gift to sustain people; thus sages moderate eating to attain the blessing of health and good fortune.
translations.idiomatic: The three sacrificial beasts and five grains issue from the five phases and become five flavors—heaven and earth's gift to sustain people—thus sages moderate eating to attain the blessing of health and good fortune.

sentences.zh: 若夫藥石者，前聖以之療疾，蓋非常食之物。

translations.literal: As for drugs and stones, former sages used them to treat illness—they are not ordinary food.
translations.idiomatic: As for drugs and stones, the former sages used them to treat illness—they are not food for ordinary use.

sentences.zh: 況金石皆含酷烈熱毒之性，加以燒治，動經歲月，既兼烈火之氣，必恐難為防制。

translations.literal: Moreover metal and stone contain fierce hot poison; with firing and refining, often over years, joined to fierce fire, they are hard to guard against.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover metal and stone contain fierce hot poison—with firing and refining, often over years, joined to fierce fire, they are hard to guard against.

sentences.zh: 若乃遠征前史，則秦、漢之君，皆信方士，如盧生、徐福、欒大、李少君，其後皆奸偽事發，其藥竟無所成。

translations.literal: Searching former histories, Qin and Han rulers all trusted formula masters—Lu Sheng, Xu Fu, Luan Da, Li Shaojun—later all proved false and their drugs achieved nothing.
translations.idiomatic: Searching former histories, Qin and Han rulers all trusted formula masters—Lu Sheng, Xu Fu, Luan Da—li Shaojun—later all proved false and their drugs achieved nothing.

sentences.zh: 事著《史記》、《漢書》，皆可驗視。

translations.literal: Recorded in the Records of the Grand Historian and Book of Han, all can be verified.
translations.idiomatic: Recorded in the Records of the Grand Historian and Book of Han—all can be verified.

sentences.zh: 《禮》曰：「君之藥，臣先嘗之；

translations.literal: The Rites says: "The ruler's medicine—the minister tastes it first;
translations.idiomatic: The Rites says: "The ruler's medicine—the minister must taste it first;

sentences.zh: 親之藥，子先嘗之。」

translations.literal: the parent's medicine—the child tastes it first."
translations.idiomatic: the parent's medicine—the child must taste it first."

sentences.zh: 臣子一也，臣願所有金石，煉藥人及所薦之人，皆先服一年，以考其真偽，則自然明驗矣。

translations.literal: Minister and child are one; I wish all metal and stone, elixir makers, and recommenders to take it first for a year to test truth and falsehood—then it will naturally be clear.
translations.idiomatic: Minister and child are one—I wish all metal and stone, elixir makers, and recommenders to take it first for a year to test truth and falsehood—then it will naturally be clear.

sentences.zh: 伏惟元和聖文神武法天應道皇帝陛下，合日月照臨之明，稟乾元利貞之德，崇正若指南，受諫如轉規，是必發精金之刃，斷可疑之網。

translations.literal: I submit that the Yuanhe sage cultural divine martial emperor who conforms to heaven and responds to the Way, combining sun and moon illumination, bearing Qian's primordial firm and yielding virtue, honoring the correct as the south-pointing needle, receiving remonstrance as turning the compass—surely will draw the keen metal blade and cut the doubtful net.
translations.idiomatic: I submit that the Yuanhe sage cultural divine martial emperor who conforms to heaven and responds to the Way, combining sun and moon illumination, bearing Qian's primordial firm and yielding virtue, honoring the correct as the south-pointing needle—receiving remonstrance as turning the compass—surely will draw the keen metal blade and cut the doubtful net.

sentences.zh: 所有藥術虛誕之徒，伏乞特賜罷遣，禁其幻惑。

translations.literal: All false men of elixir arts—I beg they be dismissed and their illusions forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Every false men of elixir arts—I beg they be dismissed and their illusions forbidden.

sentences.zh: 使浮雲盡徹，朗日增輝；

translations.literal: Let floating clouds clear utterly and the bright sun grow in radiance;
translations.idiomatic: Let the floating clouds clear away entirely and the bright sun shine with greater radiance;

sentences.zh: 道化侔羲、農，悠久配天地，實在此矣。

translations.literal: the Way matching Xi and Nong, endurance pairing with heaven and earth—in truth lies here.
translations.idiomatic: the Way matching that of Xi and Nong, endurance paired with heaven and earth—in truth the answer lies here.

sentences.zh: 伏以貞觀已來，左右起居有褚遂良、杜正倫、呂向、韋述等，鹹能竭其忠誠，悉心規諫。

translations.literal: I submit that since the Zhenguan era, left and right diarists such as Chu Suiliang, Du Zhenglun, Lü Xiang, and Wei Shu all exhausted loyalty and wholeheartedly remonstrated.
translations.idiomatic: I submit that since the Zhenguan era, left and right diarists such as Chu Suiliang, Du Zhenglun, Lü Xiang—and Wei Shu all exhausted loyalty and wholeheartedly remonstrated.

sentences.zh: 小臣謬參侍從，職奉起居，侍從之中，最近左右。

translations.literal: This petty official wrongly joins the entourage, duty serving the diary; among attendants I am nearest the person.
translations.idiomatic: This petty official wrongly joins the entourage, duty serving the diary—among attendants I am nearest the person.

sentences.zh: 傳曰：「近臣盡規。」

translations.literal: The Classic says: "Near ministers exhaust remonstrance."
translations.idiomatic: The Classic says: "Near ministers must exhaust remonstrance."

sentences.zh: 則近侍之臣，上達忠款，實其本職也。

translations.literal: Then near attendants, reaching loyalty upward, is their root duty.
translations.idiomatic: Then near attendants, reaching loyalty upward—is their root duty.

sentences.zh: 疏奏忤旨，貶為江陵令。

translations.literal: The memorial offended the intent and he was demoted to magistrate of Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial ran against the emperor's intent, and he was demoted to magistrate of Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 寶歷初，拜給事中。

translations.literal: In the beginning of Baoli he was made Supervising Censor.
translations.idiomatic: In the beginning of Baoli he was made supervising censor.

sentences.zh: 太和四年，出為汝州刺史、兼御史中丞，賜紫。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Taihe he went out as prefect of Ruzhou and concurrent Vice Censor-in-Chief, granted purple robe.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Taihe he went out as prefect of Ruzhou and concurrent vice censor-in-chief, granted purple robe.

sentences.zh: 坐違法杖殺人，貶左庶子，分司東都。

translations.literal: For illegally beating a man to death he was demoted to Left Mentor in honorary service at the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: For illegally beating a man to death he was demoted to left mentor in honorary service at the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 七年，遷左散騎常侍，充集賢殿學士。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was promoted to Left Regular Attendant and made Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was promoted to left regular attendant and made academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies.

sentences.zh: 集歷代文章續梁昭明太子《文選》，成三十卷，目曰《大和通選》，並音義、目錄一卷，上之。

translations.literal: He collected writings of successive ages continuing Prince Zhaoming of Liang's Selections of Literature, completing thirty scrolls titled Comprehensive Selections of the Great Harmony, with phonology and catalog in one scroll, and presented them.
translations.idiomatic: He collected writings of successive ages continuing Prince Zhaoming of Liang's Selections of Literature, completing thirty scrolls titled Comprehensive Selections of the Great Harmony, with phonology and catalog in one scroll—and presented them.

sentences.zh: 當時文士，非素與潾遊者，其文章少在其選，時論鹹薄之。

translations.literal: Literary men not already friendly with Lin had few pieces selected; opinion at the time belittled this.
translations.idiomatic: Literary men not already friendly with Lin had few pieces selected—opinion at the time belittled this.

sentences.zh: 八年，轉刑部侍郎，尋改華州刺史。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was transferred to Vice Minister of Justice and soon changed to prefect of Huazhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was transferred to vice minister of justice and soon changed to prefect of Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 九年，復拜刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was again made Vice Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was again made vice minister of justice.

sentences.zh: 開成元年，轉兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kaicheng he was transferred to Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Kaicheng he was transferred to vice minister of war.

sentences.zh: 二年，加集賢院學士，判院事。

translations.literal: In the second year he was added as Academician of the Academy of Assembled Worthies, directing academy affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was added as academician of the Academy of Assembled Worthies, directing academy affairs.

sentences.zh: 尋出為河南尹，入為兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: Soon he went out as governor of Henan and entered as Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he went out as governor of Henan and entered as vice minister of war.

sentences.zh: 三年四月卒，贈戶部尚書，謚曰敬。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the third year he died; posthumously made Minister of Revenue, posthumous title Respectful.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the third year he died; posthumously made minister of revenue, posthumous title Respectful.

sentences.zh: 潾以道義自處，事上盡心，尤嫉朋黨，故不為權幸所知。

translations.literal: Lin conducted himself by moral principle, serving the sovereign with full heart, especially hating factions, and thus was unknown to the powerful and favored.
translations.idiomatic: Lin conducted himself by moral principle, serving the sovereign with full heart, especially hating factions—and thus was unknown to the powerful and favored.

sentences.zh: 憲宗竟以藥誤不壽，君子以潾為知言。

translations.literal: Xianzong ultimately died short-lived from medicine error; gentlemen held that Lin had spoken truly.
translations.idiomatic: Xianzong ultimately died short-lived from medicine error—gentlemen held that Lin had spoken truly.

sentences.zh: 穆宗雖誅柳泌，既而自惑，左右近習，稍稍復進方士。

translations.literal: Though Muzong executed Liu Bi, he soon fell into delusion again; close attendants gradually brought formula masters back.
translations.idiomatic: Though Muzong executed Liu Bi, he soon fell into delusion again—close attendants gradually brought formula masters back.

sentences.zh: 時有處士張臯上疏曰：

translations.literal: At the time the recluse Zhang Gao submitted a memorial saying:
translations.idiomatic: At that time, the recluse Zhang Gao submitted a memorial saying:

sentences.zh: 神慮淡則血氣和，嗜欲勝則疾疹作。

translations.literal: When divine thought is tranquil, blood and qi are harmonious; when desire prevails, illness erupts.
translations.idiomatic: Once divine thought is tranquil, blood and qi are harmonious; when desire prevails, illness erupts.

sentences.zh: 和則必臻於壽考，作則必致於傷殘。

translations.literal: Harmony then reaches long life; eruption then brings injury and ruin.
translations.idiomatic: Harmony then reaches long life—eruption then brings injury and ruin.

sentences.zh: 是以古之聖賢，務自頤養，不以外物撓耳目，不徇聲色敗性情。

translations.literal: Thus ancient sages and worthies devoted themselves to nourishing life, not letting outer things disturb eyes and ears, not chasing sound and color to ruin nature.
translations.idiomatic: Thus ancient sages and worthies devoted themselves to nourishing life, not letting outer things disturb eyes and ears—not chasing sound and color to ruin nature.

sentences.zh: 由是和平自臻，福慶斯集。

translations.literal: From this harmony comes of itself and blessings gather.
translations.idiomatic: From such harmony peace comes of itself, and blessings gather.

sentences.zh: 故《易》曰：「無妄之疾，勿藥有喜。」

translations.literal: Thus the Changes says: "Illness without recklessness—do not medicate; there is joy."
translations.idiomatic: Thus the Changes says: "Illness without recklessness—do not medicate—there is joy."

sentences.zh: 《詩》曰：「自天降康，降福穰穰。」

translations.literal: The Odes say: "From heaven descends peace; abundant blessings descend."
translations.idiomatic: The Odes say: "From heaven descends peace—abundant blessings descend."

sentences.zh: 此皆理合天人，著在經訓。

translations.literal: These align principle with heaven and man, fixed in the classics.
translations.idiomatic: These align principle with heaven and man—fixed in the classics.

sentences.zh: 然則藥以攻疾，無疾固不可餌之也。

translations.literal: Yet medicine attacks illness; without illness one must not take it.
translations.idiomatic: Yet medicine attacks illness—without illness one must not take it.

sentences.zh: 高宗朝，處士孫思邈者，精識高道，深達攝生，所著《千金方》三十卷，行之於代。

translations.literal: In Gaozong's reign the recluse Sun Simiao, of keen insight and high Way, deeply mastered nurturing life, authored the Thousand Gold Prescriptions in thirty scrolls, practiced in the age.
translations.idiomatic: In Gaozong's reign the recluse Sun Simiao, of keen insight and high Way, deeply mastered nurturing life, authored the Thousand Gold Prescriptions in thirty scrolls—practiced in the age.

sentences.zh: 其《序論》云：「凡人無故不宜服藥，藥氣偏有所助，令人臟氣不平。」

translations.literal: His Prefatory Discussion says: "For people without cause one should not take medicine; drug qi partially assists and makes visceral qi unbalanced."
translations.idiomatic: His Prefatory Discussion says: "For people without cause one should not take medicine—drug qi partially assists and makes visceral qi unbalanced."

sentences.zh: 思邈此言，可謂洞於事理也。

translations.literal: Simiao's words penetrate affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Simiao's words cut to the heart of the matter.

sentences.zh: 或寒暑為寇，節宣有乖，事資醫方，尚須重慎。

translations.literal: When cold and heat raid or regimen errs, one relies on medical formulas—still be doubly cautious.
translations.idiomatic: Once cold and heat raid or regimen errs, one relies on medical formulas—still be doubly cautious.

sentences.zh: 故《禮》云：「醫不三代，不服其藥。」

translations.literal: Thus the Rites says: "Without three generations of physicians, do not take their medicine."
translations.idiomatic: Thus the Rites says: "Without three generations of physicians—do not take their medicine."

sentences.zh: 施於凡庶，猶且如此，況在天子，豈得自輕？

translations.literal: Applied to commoners it is so—how much more the Son of Heaven; how can he be light with himself?
translations.idiomatic: Applied to commoners it is so—how much more the the Son of Heaven; how can he be light with himself?

sentences.zh: 先朝暮年，頗好方士，征集非一，嘗試亦多；

translations.literal: The former emperor in late years quite favored formula masters, gathering not one, trying many;
translations.idiomatic: The former emperor in his late years greatly favored formula masters, gathering more than one and trying many;

sentences.zh: 果致危疾，聞於中外，足為殷鑒。

translations.literal: indeed brought grave illness, heard within and without—enough as a stern mirror.
translations.idiomatic: the result was grave illness, heard within and without—a warning clear enough for any mirror.

sentences.zh: 皆陛下素所詳知，必不可更踵前車，自貽後悔。

translations.literal: All Your Majesty has long known in detail—you absolutely must not follow the overturned cart and bring later regret.
translations.idiomatic: Every Your Majesty has long known in detail—you absolutely must not follow the overturned cart and bring later regret.

sentences.zh: 今朝野之人，紛紜竊議，直畏忤旨，莫敢獻言。

translations.literal: Now court and countryside whisper in debate, only fearing to offend the intent, none daring speak.
translations.idiomatic: Now court and countryside whisper in debate, only fearing to offend the intent—none daring speak.

sentences.zh: 臣蓬艾微生，麋鹿同處，既非邀寵，亦又何求？

translations.literal: I am humble mugwort and wormwood, dwelling with deer; neither seeking favor nor asking anything.
translations.idiomatic: I am humble mugwort and wormwood, dwelling with deer—neither seeking favor nor asking anything.

sentences.zh: 但泛覽古今，粗知忠義，有聞而默，於理不安。

translations.literal: But broadly scanning past and present, roughly knowing loyalty and righteousness, to hear and be silent is uneasy in principle.
translations.idiomatic: But broadly scanning past and present, roughly knowing loyalty and righteousness—to hear and be silent is uneasy in principle.

sentences.zh: 願陛下無怒芻蕘，庶裨萬一。

translations.literal: I wish Your Majesty not anger at rustic counsel—may it benefit one in ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: I earnestly wish Your Majesty not anger at rustic counsel—may it benefit one in ten thousand.

sentences.zh: 穆宗嘆獎其言，尋令訪臯，不獲。

translations.literal: Muzong sighed and praised his words, soon ordered a search for Gao, but he was not found.
translations.idiomatic: Muzong sighed and praised his words, soon ordered a search for Gao—but he was not found.

sentences.zh: 李中敏，隴西人。

translations.literal: Li Zhongmin was a man of Longxi.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhongmin came from Longxi.

sentences.zh: 父嬰。

translations.literal: His father Ying.
translations.idiomatic: His father's name was Ying.

sentences.zh: 中敏元和末登進士第，性剛褊敢言。

translations.literal: Zhongmin passed the civil examinations in late Yuanhe; by nature he was stern, narrow, and daring in speech.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongmin earned his jinshi degree in late Yuanhe; by nature he was stern, narrow, and daring in speech.

sentences.zh: 與進士杜牧、李甘相善，文章趣向，大率相類。

translations.literal: He was friendly with the jinshi Du Mu and Li Gan; their literary bent was largely alike.
translations.idiomatic: He was friendly with the jinshi Du Mu and Li Gan—their literary bent was largely alike.

sentences.zh: 中敏累從府辟，入為監察，歷侍御史。

translations.literal: Zhongmin repeatedly joined staff of regional offices and entered as investigating censor, serving as attendant censor.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongmin repeatedly joined staff of regional offices and entered as investigating censor—serving as attendant censor.

sentences.zh: 太和中，為司門員外郎。

translations.literal: In the Taihe era he was Director of the Gate Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In the Taihe era he was director of the gate bureau.

sentences.zh: 六年夏旱，時王守澄方寵鄭註，及誣構宋申錫後，人側目畏之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year summer drought came; Wang Shoucheng then favored Zheng Zhu, and after falsely framing Song Shenxi people glanced sideways in fear.
translations.idiomatic: During the sixth year summer drought came; Wang Shoucheng then favored Zheng Zhu, and after falsely framing Song Shenxi people glanced sideways in fear.

sentences.zh: 上以久旱，詔求致雨之方。

translations.literal: The emperor, because of long drought, edicted seeking methods to bring rain.
translations.idiomatic: Because of the long drought, the emperor issued an edict seeking methods to bring rain.

sentences.zh: 中敏上言曰：「仍歲大旱，非聖德不至，直以宋申錫之冤濫，鄭註之奸弊。

translations.literal: Zhongmin submitted: "Years of great drought are not because sacred virtue has not arrived—it is directly because of the flood of Song Shenxi's injustice and Zheng Zhu's wickedness.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongmin submitted: "Years of great drought are not because sacred virtue has failed to arrive—they come directly from the flood of injustice against Song Shenxi and the wickedness of Zheng Zhu.

sentences.zh: 今致雨之方，莫若斬鄭註而雪申錫。」

translations.literal: The method to bring rain now is none other than executing Zheng Zhu and clearing Shenxi."
translations.idiomatic: The method to bring rain now is none other than to execute Zheng Zhu and clear Shenxi's name."

sentences.zh: 士大夫皆危之，疏留中不下。

translations.literal: Gentlemen all feared it; the memorial was kept within and not issued.
translations.idiomatic: Gentlemen all feared it—the memorial was kept within and not issued.

sentences.zh: 明年，中敏謝病歸洛陽。

translations.literal: The next year Zhongmin resigned on illness and returned to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Zhongmin resigned citing illness and returned to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 及訓、註誅，竟雪申錫，召中敏為司勛員外郎。

translations.literal: When Xun and Zhu were executed, Shenxi was finally cleared; Zhongmin was summoned as Director of Merits.
translations.idiomatic: When Xun and Zhu were executed, Shenxi was finally cleared; Zhongmin was summoned as director of merits.

sentences.zh: 尋遷刑部郎中，知臺雜。

translations.literal: Soon promoted to Director of Justice, knowing censorate miscellaneous affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Soon promoted to director of justice, knowing censorate miscellaneous affairs.

sentences.zh: 其年，拜諫議大夫，充理匭使。

translations.literal: That year he was made Remonstrance and Policy Advisor and charged as commissioner of the complaint box.
translations.idiomatic: That year he was made remonstrance and policy advisor and charged as commissioner of the complaint box.

sentences.zh: 上言曰：「據舊例，投匭進狀人先以副本呈匭使，或詭異難行者，不令進入。

translations.literal: He submitted: "According to old precedent, one who submits a complaint first presents a copy to the box commissioner; if strange or hard to execute, it is not allowed entry.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote: "According to old precedent, one who submits a complaint first presents a copy to the box commissioner; if strange or hard to execute, it is not allowed entry.

sentences.zh: 臣檢尋文按，不見本敕，所由但雲貞元奉宣，恐是一時之事。

translations.literal: I searched documents and do not see the original edict; those responsible only say a Zhenyuan oral order—perhaps a momentary matter.
translations.idiomatic: I searched documents and do not see the original edict—those responsible only say a Zhenyuan oral order—perhaps a momentary matter.

sentences.zh: 臣以為本置匭函，每日從內將出，日暮進入，意在使冤濫無告，有司不為申理者，或論時政，或陳利害；

translations.literal: I hold that the complaint box was set so daily it is brought out from within and entered at dusk, intending that the wronged with no recourse, whom offices do not redress, or who discuss policy or state harm;
translations.idiomatic: I maintain that the complaint box was set so daily it is brought out from within and entered at dusk, intending that the wronged with no recourse, whom offices do not redress, or who discuss policy or state harm;

sentences.zh: 宜開其必達之路，所以廣聰明而慮幽枉也。

translations.literal: should open a path that must reach, thereby broadening intelligence and considering hidden wrong.
translations.idiomatic: should open a path that must reach the throne, thereby broadening intelligence and weighing hidden wrongs.

sentences.zh: 若令有司先見，裁其可否，即非重密其事，俾壅塞自伸於九重之意。

translations.literal: If offices see first and judge yes or no, that is not keeping it secret and letting blockage speak to the ninefold court's intent.
translations.idiomatic: If offices see submissions first and judge yes or no, that is not keeping the matter secret and letting the blocked speak to the intent of the ninefold court.

sentences.zh: 臣伏請今後所有進狀及封事，臣但為引進，取舍可否，斷自中旨。

translations.literal: I beg that hereafter all submitted complaints and sealed memorials—I only introduce them; accept or reject rests on central edict.
translations.idiomatic: I beg that hereafter all submitted complaints and sealed memorials—I only introduce them—accept or reject rests on central edict.

sentences.zh: 庶使名實在茲，以明置匭之本。」

translations.literal: Then name and reality will be here, clarifying the root of setting the box."
translations.idiomatic: In that case name and reality will be here, clarifying the root of setting the box."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was followed.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 尋拜給事中。

translations.literal: Soon he was made Supervising Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was made supervising censor.

sentences.zh: 李甘，字和鼎。

translations.literal: Li Gan, styled Heding.
translations.idiomatic: Li Gan, courtesy name Heding.

sentences.zh: 長慶末，進士擢第，又制策登科。

translations.literal: In late Changqing he passed the civil examinations and also passed the decree examination.
translations.idiomatic: In late Changqing he earned his jinshi degree and also passed the decree examination.

sentences.zh: 太和中，累官至侍御史。

translations.literal: In Taihe he rose repeatedly to Attendant Censor.
translations.idiomatic: In Taihe he rose repeatedly to attendant censor.

sentences.zh: 鄭註入翰林侍講，舒元輿既作相，註亦求入中書。

translations.literal: When Zheng Zhu entered Hanlin to lecture and Shu Yuanyu had become chief minister, Zhu also sought entry to the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Once Zheng Zhu entered Hanlin to lecture and Shu Yuanyu had become chief minister, Zhu also sought entry to the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 甘唱於朝曰：「宰相者，代天理物，先德望而後文藝。

translations.literal: Gan proclaimed at court: "Chief ministers substitute for heaven and order things—first virtue and repute, then literary talent.
translations.idiomatic: Gan proclaimed at court: "Chief ministers substitute for heaven and order things—first virtue and repute—then literary talent.

sentences.zh: 註乃何人，敢茲叨竊？

translations.literal: What sort is Zhu to dare such usurpation?
translations.idiomatic: What sort of man is Zhu to dare such usurpation?

sentences.zh: 白麻若出，吾必壞之。」

translations.literal: If white hemp edict issues, I will surely ruin it.
translations.idiomatic: If white hemp edict issues—i will surely ruin it.

sentences.zh: 會李訓亦惡註之所求，相註之事竟寢。

translations.literal: When Li Xun also hated Zhu's request, the matter of making Zhu chief minister finally slept.
translations.idiomatic: Once Li Xun also hated Zhu's request, the matter of making Zhu chief minister finally slept.

sentences.zh: 訓不獲已，貶甘封州司馬。

translations.literal: Xun had no choice; Gan was demoted to secretary in Fengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Xun had no choice—Gan was demoted to secretary in Fengzhou.

sentences.zh: 又有李款者，與中敏同時為侍御史。

translations.literal: There was also Li Kuan, attendant censor at the same time as Zhongmin.
translations.idiomatic: There was also Li Kuan, who served as attendant censor alongside Zhongmin.

sentences.zh: 鄭註邠寧入朝，款伏閣彈註云：「內通敕使，外結朝官，兩地往來，卜射財貨。」

translations.literal: When Zheng Zhu entered court from Binning, Kuan prostrated at the gate and impeached Zhu: "Within he connects with edict envoys; without he knots with court officials; going between both places, divining and shooting for wealth."
translations.idiomatic: Once Zheng Zhu entered court from Binning, Kuan prostrated at the gate and impeached Zhu: "Within he connects with edict envoys; without he knots with court officials; going between both places, divining and shooting for wealth."

sentences.zh: 文宗不之省。

translations.literal: Emperor Wenzong did not examine it.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wenzong did not look into it.

sentences.zh: 及註用事，款亦被逐。

translations.literal: When Zhu held power, Kuan was also driven out.
translations.idiomatic: Once Zhu held power, Kuan was also driven out.

sentences.zh: 開成中，累官至諫議大夫，出為蘇州刺史，遷洪州刺史、江西觀察使。

translations.literal: In Kaicheng he rose repeatedly to Remonstrance and Policy Advisor, went out as prefect of Suzhou, promoted to prefect of Hongzhou and Jiangxi observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaicheng he rose repeatedly to remonstrance and policy advisor, went out as prefect of Suzhou, promoted to prefect of Hongzhou and Jiangxi observation commissioner.

sentences.zh: 杜牧自有傳。

translations.literal: Du Mu has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: Du Mu has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 高元裕，字景圭，渤海人。

translations.literal: Gao Yuanyu, styled Jinggui, was a man of Bohai.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Yuanyu, courtesy name Jinggui, came from Bohai.

sentences.zh: 祖甝。

translations.literal: His grandfather Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather's name was Zhen.

sentences.zh: 父集，官卑。

translations.literal: His father Ji held low office.
translations.idiomatic: His father Ji served in a minor post.

sentences.zh: 元裕登進士第，本名允中，太和初，為侍御史，奏改元裕。

translations.literal: Yuanyu passed the civil examinations; originally named Yunzhong; in early Taihe as attendant censor he memorialized to change to Yuanyu.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanyu earned his jinshi degree; originally named Yunzhong; in early Taihe as attendant censor he memorialized to change to Yuanyu.

sentences.zh: 累遷左司郎中。

translations.literal: He was promoted repeatedly to Director of the Left Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted repeatedly to director of the left bureau.

sentences.zh: 李宗閔作相，用為諫議大夫，尋改中書舍人。

translations.literal: When Li Zongmin became chief minister he was used as Remonstrance and Policy Advisor, soon changed to Secretariat Drafter.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Zongmin became chief minister he was used as remonstrance and policy advisor, soon changed to secretariat drafter.

sentences.zh: 九年，宗閔得罪南遷，元裕出城餞送，為李訓所怒，出為閬州刺史。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Zongmin offended and was sent south; Yuanyu went outside the city to see him off; Li Xun was angered and sent him out as prefect of Langzhou.
translations.idiomatic: During the ninth year Zongmin offended and was sent south; Yuanyu went outside the city to see him off; Li Xun was angered and sent him out as prefect of Langzhou.

sentences.zh: 時鄭註入翰林，元裕草註制辭，言註以醫藥奉召親，註怒。

translations.literal: At the time Zheng Zhu entered Hanlin; Yuanyu drafted Zhu's appointment text saying Zhu was summoned close for medicine; Zhu was angered.
translations.idiomatic: At that time, Zheng Zhu entered Hanlin; Yuanyu drafted Zhu's appointment text saying Zhu was summoned close for medicine; Zhu was angered.

sentences.zh: 會送宗閔，乃貶之。

translations.literal: When seeing Zongmin off, he was demoted.
translations.idiomatic: Once seeing Zongmin off, he was demoted.

sentences.zh: 訓、註既誅，復征為諫議大夫。

translations.literal: After Xun and Zhu were executed he was recalled as Remonstrance and Policy Advisor.
translations.idiomatic: After Xun and Zhu were executed he was recalled as remonstrance and policy advisor.

sentences.zh: 開成三年，充翰林侍講學士。

translations.literal: In the third year of Kaicheng he was made Hanlin Lecturer.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Kaicheng he was made Hanlin lecturer.

sentences.zh: 文宗寵莊恪太子，欲正人為師友。

translations.literal: Emperor Wenzong favored the Heir Apparent Zhuangke and wished upright men as teachers and friends.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wenzong favored the heir apparent Zhuangke and wished upright men as teachers and friends.

sentences.zh: 乃兼太子賓客。

translations.literal: He was also made Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He was also made grand mentor of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 四年，改御史中丞，風望峻整。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he changed to Censor-in-Chief; his bearing was stern and ordered.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he changed to censor-in-chief; his bearing was stern and ordered.

sentences.zh: 上言曰：「御史府紀綱之地，官屬選用，宜得實才。

translations.literal: He submitted: "The censorate is the place of discipline; choosing officials should gain real talent.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote: "The censorate is the place of discipline; choosing officials should gain real talent.

sentences.zh: 其不稱者，臣請出之。」

translations.literal: Those unfit—I beg to remove them."
translations.idiomatic: Such unfit—I beg to remove them."

sentences.zh: 監察御史杜宣猷、柳壞、崔郢、侍御史魏中庸、高弘簡，並以不稱，出為府縣之職。

translations.literal: Investigating censors Du Xuanyi, Liu Huai, Cui Ying, attendant censors Wei Zhongyong and Gao Hongjian—all unfit, sent out to prefecture and county posts.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating censors Du Xuanyi, Liu Huai, Cui Ying, attendant censors Wei Zhongyong and Gao Hongjian—all unfit—sent out to prefecture and county posts.

sentences.zh: 尋而藍田縣人賀蘭，進與裏內五十余人相聚念佛，神策鎮將皆捕之，以為謀逆，當大辟。

translations.literal: Soon Lantian man Helan Jin and more than fifty within the lane gathered to chant Buddha; Shence garrison generals all arrested them as plotting rebellion, capital punishment due.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, Lantian man Helan Jin and more than fifty within the lane gathered to chant Buddha; Shence garrison generals all arrested them as plotting rebellion, capital punishment due.

sentences.zh: 元裕疑其冤，上疏請出賀蘭進等付臺覆問，然後行刑，從之。

translations.literal: Yuanyu doubted the injustice and memorialized to send Helan Jin and others to the censorate for re-examination before execution; it was followed.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanyu doubted the injustice and memorialized to send Helan Jin and others to the censorate for re-examination before execution—it was followed.

sentences.zh: 會昌中，為京兆尹。

translations.literal: In the Huichang era he was Jingzhao governor.
translations.idiomatic: During the the Huichang era he was Jingzhao governor.

sentences.zh: 大中初，為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: In early Dazhong he was Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In early Dazhong he was minister of justice.

sentences.zh: 二年，檢校吏部尚書、襄州刺史，加銀青光祿大夫、渤海郡公、山南東道節度使。

translations.literal: In the second year he was made acting Minister of Civil Office and prefect of Xiangzhou, added Silver and Blue Glory Grand Master, Duke of Bohai, military commissioner of Shannan East Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was made acting minister of civil office and prefect of Xiangzhou, added silver and blue glory grand master, duke of Bohai, military commissioner of Shannan East Circuit.

sentences.zh: 入為吏部尚書，卒。

translations.literal: He entered as Minister of Civil Office and died.
translations.idiomatic: He entered as minister of civil office and died.

sentences.zh: 元裕兄少逸、元恭。

translations.literal: Yuanyu's elder brothers Shaoyi and Yuangong.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanyu's elder brothers were Shaoyi and Yuangong.

sentences.zh: 少逸，長慶末為侍御史，坐弟元裕貶官，左授贊善大夫，累遷左司郎中。

translations.literal: Shaoyi in late Changqing was attendant censor; for younger brother Yuanyu's demotion he was demoted to mentor; rose repeatedly to Director of the Left Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Shaoyi in late Changqing was attendant censor; for younger brother Yuanyu's demotion he was demoted to mentor; rose repeatedly to director of the left bureau.

sentences.zh: 元裕為中丞，少逸遷諫議大夫，代元裕為侍講學士。

translations.literal: When Yuanyu was censor-in-chief, Shaoyi was promoted to Remonstrance and Policy Advisor, replacing Yuanyu as lecturer.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuanyu was censor-in-chief, Shaoyi was promoted to remonstrance and policy advisor, replacing Yuanyu as lecturer.

sentences.zh: 兄弟叠處禁密，時人榮之。

translations.literal: Brothers stacked in forbidden intimacy; men of the time honored it.
translations.idiomatic: Brothers stacked in forbidden intimacy; men of the time honored the sight.

sentences.zh: 會昌中，為給事中，多所封奏。

translations.literal: In Huichang he was Supervising Censor, many sealed memorials.
translations.idiomatic: In Huichang he was supervising censor, many sealed memorials.

sentences.zh: 大中初，檢校禮部尚書、華州刺史、潼關防禦、鎮國軍使。

translations.literal: In early Dazhong he was acting Minister of Rites, prefect of Huazhou, Tongguan defense, Zhenguo army commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In early Dazhong he was acting minister of rites, prefect of Huazhou, Tongguan defense, Zhenguo army commissioner.

sentences.zh: 入為左散騎常侍、工部尚書，卒。

translations.literal: He entered as Left Regular Attendant and Minister of Works and died.
translations.idiomatic: He entered as left regular attendant and minister of works and died.

sentences.zh: 元裕子璩，登進士第。

translations.literal: Yuanyu's son Qu passed the civil examinations.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanyu's son Qu earned his jinshi degree.

sentences.zh: 大中朝，由內外制歷丞郎，判度支。

translations.literal: In the Dazhong court, through inner and outer drafting he served as vice director, judging revenue.
translations.idiomatic: During the Dazhong court, through inner and outer drafting he served as vice director, judging revenue.

sentences.zh: 咸通中，守中書侍郎、平章事。

translations.literal: In the Xiantong era he held Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: In the Xiantong era he held vice director of the Secretariat and grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 李漢，字南紀，宗室淮陽王道明之後。

translations.literal: Li Han, styled Nanji, descended from Prince Huaiyang Daoming of the imperial clan.
translations.idiomatic: Li Han, courtesy name Nanji, descended from Prince Huaiyang Daoming of the imperial clan.

sentences.zh: 道明生景融，景融生務該，務該生思，思生岌。

translations.literal: Daoming begot Jingrong, Jingrong begot Wugai, Wugai begot Si, Si begot Ji.
translations.idiomatic: Daoming begot Jingrong, Jingrong begot Wugai, Wugai begot Si—si begot Ji.

sentences.zh: 岌已上無名位，及岌為蜀州晉原尉。

translations.literal: Above Ji there were no names or offices; Ji was assistant magistrate of Jinyuan in Shuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Before Ji the line is untraceable in office; Ji was assistant magistrate of Jinyuan in Shuzhou

sentences.zh: 岌生荊，荊為陜州司馬。

translations.literal: Ji begot Jing; Jing was secretary in Shaanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Ji was the father of Jing; Jing was secretary in Shaanzhou.

sentences.zh: 荊生漢。

translations.literal: Jing begot Han.
translations.idiomatic: Jing was the father of Han.

sentences.zh: 漢，元和七年登進士第，累辟使府。

translations.literal: Han passed the civil examinations in the seventh year of Yuanhe and repeatedly joined commissioner staffs.
translations.idiomatic: Han earned his jinshi degree in the seventh year of Yuanhe and repeatedly joined commissioner staffs.

sentences.zh: 長慶末，為左拾遺。

translations.literal: In late Changqing he was Left Reminder.
translations.idiomatic: In late Changqing he was left reminder.

sentences.zh: 敬宗好治宮室，波斯賈人李蘇沙獻沈香亭子材。

translations.literal: Jingzong loved building palaces; Persian merchant Li Susha presented agarwood pavilion timber.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzong loved building palaces—Persian merchant Li Susha presented agarwood pavilion timber.

sentences.zh: 漢上疏論之曰：「若以沈香為亭子，即與瑤臺瓊室事同。」

translations.literal: Han memorialized: "If agarwood makes a pavilion, it is the same as jade tower and jasper chamber."
translations.idiomatic: Han memorialized: "If agarwood is used to build a pavilion, the deed is no different from raising a jade tower or jasper chamber."

sentences.zh: 寶歷中，王政日僻，漢與同列薛廷老，因入閣，廷奏曰：「近日除授不由中書，擬議多是宣出施行。

translations.literal: In Baoli, royal government daily declined; Han and colleague Xue Tinglao, entering the gate, Ting memorialized: "Lately appointments do not pass the Secretariat; deliberation is mostly proclaimed and executed.
translations.idiomatic: In Baoli, royal government daily declined—Han and colleague Xue Tinglao, entering the gate, Ting memorialized: "Lately appointments do not pass the Secretariat—deliberation is mostly proclaimed and executed.

sentences.zh: 臣恐自此紀綱大壞，奸邪恣行。

translations.literal: I fear from this discipline will greatly break and wicked will run wild.
translations.idiomatic: I fear that from this point discipline will collapse and the wicked will run wild.

sentences.zh: 願陛下各敕有司，稍存典故。」

translations.literal: I wish Your Majesty to charge each office to slightly preserve statutes."
translations.idiomatic: I earnestly wish Your Majesty to charge each office to slightly preserve statutes."

sentences.zh: 坐言忤旨，出為興元從事。

translations.literal: For words offending intent he was sent out as aide in Xingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: For words that offended the emperor's intent he was sent out as aide in Xingyuan.

sentences.zh: 文宗即位，召為屯田員外郎、史館修撰。

translations.literal: When Wenzong took the throne Han was summoned as Director of the Fields Bureau and historiography compiler.
translations.idiomatic: When Wenzong took the throne Han was summoned as director of the fields bureau and historiography compiler.

sentences.zh: 漢，韓愈子婿，少師愈為文，長於古學，剛訐亦類愈。

translations.literal: Han was son-in-law of Han Yu; Junior Tutor Yu wrote in ancient learning; stern and cutting he resembled Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Han was son-in-law of Han Yu—Junior Tutor Yu wrote in ancient learning—stern and cutting he resembled Yu.

sentences.zh: 預修《憲宗實錄》，尤為李德裕所憎。

translations.literal: Participating in compiling the Veritable Records of Xianzong, he was especially hated by Li Deyu.
translations.idiomatic: Participating in compiling the Veritable Records of Xianzong—he was especially hated by Li Deyu.

sentences.zh: 太和四年，轉兵部員外郎。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Taihe he was transferred to Vice Director of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Taihe he was transferred to vice director of war.

sentences.zh: 李宗閔作相，用為知制誥，尋遷駕部郎中。

translations.literal: When Li Zongmin became chief minister he was used as Drafting Commissioner, soon promoted to Director of the Imperial Carriages Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Zongmin became chief minister he was used as drafting commissioner, soon promoted to director of the imperial carriages bureau.

sentences.zh: 八年，代宇文鼎為御史中丞。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he replaced Yuwen Ding as Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he replaced Yuwen Ding as censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 時李程為左僕射，以儀註不定，奏請定制。

translations.literal: At the time Li Cheng was Left Vice Director; because ritual was unsettled he memorialized to fix regulations.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Li Cheng was left vice director; because ritual was unsettled he memorialized to fix regulations.

sentences.zh: 先是，太和三年，兩省官同定左右僕射儀註：御史中丞已下，與僕射相遇，依令致敬，斂馬側立待。

translations.literal: Earlier, in the third year of Taihe, officials of two departments jointly fixed left and right vice director ritual: below Vice Censor-in-Chief, meeting vice directors, according to statute bow, rein in horse and stand aside waiting.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, in the third year of Taihe, officials of two departments jointly fixed left and right vice director ritual: below vice censor-in-chief, meeting vice directors, according to statute bow, rein in horse and stand aside waiting.

sentences.zh: 僕射謝官日，大夫中丞、三院御史，就幕次參見，其觀象門外立班，既以後至為重。

translations.literal: On vice directors' thanks-for-appointment day, grandee, vice director, and three bureaus' censors visit at curtain; outside Observing Elephant Gate they stand in file—later arrival is heavier.
translations.idiomatic: On vice directors' thanks-for-appointment day, grandee, vice director, and three bureaus' censors visit at curtain—outside Observing Elephant Gate they stand in file—later arrival is heavier.

sentences.zh: 大夫中丞到班後，朝堂所由引僕射就位，傳呼贊導，始大夫就列之儀。

translations.literal: After grandee and vice director reach the file, court ushers lead vice director to place, call and guide; then grandee takes column ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Following grandee and vice director reach the file, court ushers lead vice director to place, call and guide; then grandee takes column ritual.

sentences.zh: 班退，贊導亦如之。

translations.literal: When file withdraws, guiding is likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Once file withdraws, guiding is likewise.

sentences.zh: 御史大夫與僕射道途相遇，則分道而行。

translations.literal: When Censor-in-Chief and vice director meet on the road they take separate paths.
translations.idiomatic: When censor-in-chief and vice director meet on the road they take separate paths.

sentences.zh: 舊事，左右僕射初上，御史中丞、吏部侍郎已下羅拜。

translations.literal: Old matter: when left and right vice directors first ascend, Vice Censor-in-Chief and Vice Minister of Civil Office below bow in file.
translations.idiomatic: Old matter: when left and right vice directors first ascend, vice censor-in-chief and vice minister of civil office below bow in file.

sentences.zh: 四年，中書奏曰：「僕射受中丞侍郎拜，則似太重；

translations.literal: In the fourth year the Secretariat memorialized: "Vice directors receiving vice director and minister bow seems too heavy;
translations.idiomatic: "In the fourth year the Secretariat memorialized: "Vice directors receiving vice director and minister bow seems too heavy;

sentences.zh: 答郎官已下拜，則太輕。

translations.literal: answering bow of officials below seems too light.
translations.idiomatic: returning the bow of officials below seems too slight.

sentences.zh: 起今後，諸司四品已下官，及御史臺六品已下並郎官，並望準故事，余依元和七年敕處分。」

translations.literal: From now, all offices rank four and below and censorate rank six and below and bureau officials—all hope to follow old matter; the rest per Yuanhe seventh year edict."
translations.idiomatic: From now, all offices rank four and below and censorate rank six and below and bureau officials—all hope to follow old matter—the rest per Yuanhe seventh year edict."

sentences.zh: 可之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 至是，因李程奏，漢議曰：「左右僕射初上，受左右丞、諸曹侍郎、諸司四品及御史中丞已下拜。

translations.literal: At this time because of Li Cheng's memorial, Han argued: "When left and right vice directors first ascend, they receive bow of left and right assistants, various bureau vice ministers, office rank four and Censor-in-Chief below.
translations.idiomatic: At this time because of Li Cheng's memorial, Han argued: "When left and right vice directors first ascend, they receive bow of left and right assistants, various bureau vice ministers, office rank four and censor-in-chief below.

sentences.zh: 謹按《開元禮》及《六典》，並無此儀註，不知所起之由。

translations.literal: I respectfully check Kaiyuan Rites and Six Offices—no such ritual; unknown whence it arose.
translations.idiomatic: I respectfully check Kaiyuan Rites and Six Offices—no such ritual—unknown whence it arose.

sentences.zh: 或以為僕射師長百僚，此語亦無證據，唯有曹魏時賈詡《讓官表》中一句語耳。

translations.literal: Some think vice director is teacher to hundred officials—this also has no evidence, only one phrase in Jia Xu's Resignation Memorial in Cao Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Some think vice director is teacher to hundred officials—this also has no evidence—only one phrase in Jia Xu's Resignation Memorial in Cao Wei.

sentences.zh: 且尚書令是正長，尚無受拜之文。

translations.literal: Moreover Director of State Affairs is proper chief—no text of receiving bow.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover director of state affairs is proper chief—no text of receiving bow.

sentences.zh: 故事，與御史中丞、司隸校尉，號三獨坐。

translations.literal: Old matter: with Vice Censor-in-Chief and Director of Convicts they are called Three Sole Seats.
translations.idiomatic: Old matter: with vice censor-in-chief and director of convicts they are called Three Sole Seats.

sentences.zh: 伏以朝廷比肩，同事聖主，南面受拜，臣下何安？

translations.literal: I submit the court stands shoulder to shoulder, serving the same sage lord—facing south receiving bow, how can subjects be at ease?
translations.idiomatic: Respectfully, I submit the court stands shoulder to shoulder, serving the same sage lord—facing south receiving bow, how can subjects be at ease?

sentences.zh: 縱有明文，尚須厘革。

translations.literal: Even if there is clear text, it still must be reformed.
translations.idiomatic: Even where there is clear text, the practice still must be reformed.

sentences.zh: 故《禮記》曰：『君於士不答拜，非其臣則答之。』

translations.literal: Thus the Record of Rites says: 'The ruler to knights does not return bow; if not his subject then he returns.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the Record of Rites says: 'The ruler to knights does not return bow—if not his subject then he returns.

sentences.zh: 況御史中丞、殿中御史是供奉官，尤為不可。

translations.literal: How much more Vice Censor-in-Chief and Palace Censor are attendance officials—especially impossible.
translations.idiomatic: How much more vice censor-in-chief and palace censor are attendance officials—especially impossible.

sentences.zh: 儀制令雖有隔品之文，不知便是受拜否？

translations.literal: Ritual statutes have text on separated rank—unknown whether that is receiving bow?
translations.idiomatic: The ritual statutes contain language on separated rank—it is unclear whether that means receiving bow.

sentences.zh: 及御史大夫，亦曾受御史已下拜，今並不行。

translations.literal: And Censor-in-Chief also once received bow of censors below—now all not practiced.
translations.idiomatic: And censor-in-chief also once received bow of censors below—now all not practiced.

sentences.zh: 蓋以禮數僭逼，非人臣所安。

translations.literal: Because ritual number oversteps— not what subjects can bear.
translations.idiomatic: Because ritual number oversteps—not what subjects can bear.

sentences.zh: 元和六年七月，詔崔邠、段平仲與當時禮官王涇、韋公肅等同議其事，理甚精詳。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the sixth year of Yuanhe edicted Cui Bin, Duan Pingzhong with ritual officials Wang Jing and Wei Gongsu to jointly discuss—reason very detailed.
translations.idiomatic: During the seventh month of the sixth year of Yuanhe edicted Cui Bin, Duan Pingzhong with ritual officials Wang Jing and Wei Gongsu to jointly discuss—reason very detailed.

sentences.zh: 今請舉而行之，庶為折衷。」

translations.literal: Now please raise and practice—may it be compromise."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that it now be raised up and put into practice—may that serve as a workable compromise."

sentences.zh: 時程入省，竟依舊儀，議者以漢奏為是。

translations.literal: When Cheng entered the ministry, finally followed old ritual; debaters held Han's memorial correct.
translations.idiomatic: When Cheng entered the ministry, finally followed old ritual—debaters held Han's memorial correct.

sentences.zh: 七年，轉禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was transferred to Vice Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was transferred to vice minister of rites.

sentences.zh: 八年。

translations.literal: In the eighth year.
translations.idiomatic: That was in the eighth year.

sentences.zh: 改戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: Changed to Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Changed to vice minister of revenue.

sentences.zh: 九年四月，轉吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the ninth year transferred to Vice Minister of Civil Office.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the ninth year transferred to vice minister of civil office.

sentences.zh: 六月，李宗閔得罪罷相，漢坐其黨，出為汾州刺史。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Li Zongmin offended and left the chief ministry; Han sat in his faction and was sent out as prefect of Fenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: During the sixth month Li Zongmin offended and left the chief ministry; Han sat in his faction and was sent out as prefect of Fenzhou.

sentences.zh: 宗閔再貶，漢亦改汾州司馬，仍三二十年不得錄用。

translations.literal: Zongmin was demoted again; Han also changed to secretary in Fenzhou, still two or three decades without employment.
translations.idiomatic: Zongmin was demoted again—Han also changed to secretary in Fenzhou, still two or three decades without employment.

sentences.zh: 會昌中，李德裕用事，漢竟淪躓而卒。

translations.literal: In Huichang Li Deyu held power; Han ultimately stumbled and died.
translations.idiomatic: In Huichang Li Deyu held power—Han ultimately stumbled and died.

sentences.zh: 漢弟浐、洗、潘，皆登進士第。

translations.literal: Han's younger brothers Chan, Xi, and Pan all passed civil examinations.
translations.idiomatic: Han's younger brothers Chan, Xi, and Pan all earned jinshi degrees.

sentences.zh: 潘，大中初為禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: Pan in early Dazhong was Vice Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Pan in early Dazhong was vice minister of rites.

sentences.zh: 漢子貺，亦登進士第。

translations.literal: Han's son Kuang also passed civil examinations.
translations.idiomatic: Han's son Kuang also earned jinshi degrees.

sentences.zh: 李景儉，字寬中，漢中王瑀之孫。

translations.literal: Li Jingjian, styled Kuanzhong, was grandson of Prince of Hanzhong Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jingjian, courtesy name Kuanzhong, was grandson of the Prince of Hanzhong, Yu.

sentences.zh: 父褚，太子中舍。

translations.literal: His father Chu was Mentor in the Heir Apparent's household.
translations.idiomatic: His father Chu was mentor in the heir apparent's household.

sentences.zh: 景儉，貞元十五年登進士第。

translations.literal: Jingjian passed civil examinations in the fifteenth year of Zhenyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Jingjian earned jinshi degrees in the fifteenth year of Zhenyuan.

sentences.zh: 性俊朗，博聞強記，頗閱前史，詳其成敗。

translations.literal: By nature handsome and bright, broadly read with strong memory, quite perused former histories, detailed in success and failure.
translations.idiomatic: By nature handsome and bright, broadly read with strong memory, quite perused former histories—detailed in success and failure.

sentences.zh: 自負王霸之略，於士大夫間無所屈降。

translations.literal: Self-confident in hegemon-king stratagems, among gentlemen he bowed to none.
translations.idiomatic: Self-confident in hegemon-king stratagems—among gentlemen he bowed to none.

sentences.zh: 貞元末，韋執誼、王叔文東宮用事，尤重之，待以管、葛之才。

translations.literal: In late Zhenyuan Wei Zhiyi and Wang Shuwen wielded power in the Eastern Palace and especially valued him, treating him as Guan and Zhuge talent.
translations.idiomatic: In late Zhenyuan Wei Zhiyi and Wang Shuwen wielded power in the Eastern Palace and especially valued him—treating him as Guan and Zhuge talent.

sentences.zh: 叔文竊政，屬景儉居母喪，故不及從坐。

translations.literal: When Shuwen seized government Jingjian was in mourning for his mother and thus did not sit in the punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Once Shuwen seized government Jingjian was in mourning for his mother and thus did not sit in the punishment.

sentences.zh: 韋夏卿留守東都，辟為從事。

translations.literal: Wei Xiaqing remained at the Eastern Capital and recruited him as aide.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Xiaqing, remaining at the Eastern Capital, recruited him as an aide.

sentences.zh: 竇君為御史中丞，引為監察御史。

translations.literal: Dou Qun as Censor-in-Chief led him as Investigating Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Qun as censor-in-chief led him as investigating censor.

sentences.zh: 群以罪左遷，景儉坐貶江陵戶曹。

translations.literal: When Qun was demoted for crime Jingjian sat and was demoted to revenue clerk in Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: Once Qun was demoted for crime Jingjian sat and was demoted to revenue clerk in Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 累轉忠州刺史。

translations.literal: Transferred repeatedly to prefect of Zhongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred repeatedly, ending as prefect of Zhongzhou.

sentences.zh: 元和末入朝。

translations.literal: At the end of Yuanhe he entered court.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Yuanhe era he entered court.

sentences.zh: 執政惡之，出為澧州刺史。

translations.literal: The administration hated him and sent him out as prefect of Li.
translations.idiomatic: The administration disliked him and sent him out as prefect of Li.

sentences.zh: 與元稹、李紳相善。

translations.literal: He was friendly with Yuan Zhen and Li Shen.
translations.idiomatic: He was on close terms with Yuan Zhen and Li Shen.

sentences.zh: 時紳、稹在翰林，屢言於上前。

translations.literal: When Shen and Zhen were in Hanlin they spoke repeatedly before the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Once Shen and Zhen were in Hanlin they spoke repeatedly before the emperor.

sentences.zh: 及延英辭日，景儉自陳己屈，穆宗憐之，追詔拜倉部員外郎。

translations.literal: On Yanying leave day Jingjian stated his own wrong; Muzong pitied him and recalled edict making him Vice Director of Granaries.
translations.idiomatic: On Yanying leave day Jingjian stated his own wrong; Muzong pitied him and recalled edict making him vice director of granaries.

sentences.zh: 月余，驟遷諫議大夫。

translations.literal: After a little more than a month he was suddenly promoted to Remonstrance and Policy Advisor.
translations.idiomatic: After a little more than a month he was suddenly promoted to remonstrance and policy advisor.

sentences.zh: 性既矜誕，寵擢之後，淩蔑公卿大臣，使酒尤甚。

translations.literal: Nature proud and unrestrained, after favor he looked down on grandees and great ministers, especially given to wine.
translations.idiomatic: Nature proud and unrestrained, after favor he looked down on grandees and great ministers—especially given to wine.

sentences.zh: 中丞蕭俛、學士段文昌相交輔政，景儉輕之，形於談謔。

translations.literal: Vice Censor-in-Chief Xiao Xian and Academician Duan Wenchang jointly aided government; Jingjian slighted them, shown in jest.
translations.idiomatic: Vice censor-in-chief Xiao Xian and academician Duan Wenchang jointly aided government; Jingjian slighted them, shown in jest.

sentences.zh: 二人俱訴之，穆宗不獲已，貶之。

translations.literal: Both complained; Muzong had no choice and demoted him.
translations.idiomatic: Both complained—Muzong had no choice and demoted him.

sentences.zh: 制曰：「諫議大夫李景儉，擢自宗枝，嘗探儒術，薦歷臺閣，亦分郡符。

translations.literal: The edict said: "Remonstrance and Policy Advisor Li Jingjian, raised from the clan branch, once explored Confucian arts, recommended through terraces and pavilions, also shared prefect's tally.
translations.idiomatic: The edict said: "Remonstrance and policy advisor Li Jingjian, raised from the clan branch, once explored Confucian arts, recommended through terraces and pavilions, also shared prefect's tally.

sentences.zh: 動或違仁，行不由義。

translations.literal: Conduct sometimes strayed from benevolence; action did not follow righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: Conduct sometimes strayed from benevolence—action did not follow righteousness.

sentences.zh: 附權幸以虧節，通奸黨之陰謀。

translations.literal: Clinging to the powerful to lose integrity, connecting with wicked factions' secret plots.
translations.idiomatic: He clung to the powerful and lost his integrity, connecting with the secret plots of wicked factions.

sentences.zh: 眾情皆疑，群議難息。

translations.literal: All feelings suspect; group debate hard to quiet.
translations.idiomatic: All feelings suspect—group debate hard to quiet.

sentences.zh: 據因緣之狀，當置嚴科；

translations.literal: According to the circumstance of connection, strict punishment should be set;
translations.idiomatic: Given the circumstances of his associations, strict punishment would be fitting;

sentences.zh: 順長養之時，特從寬典。

translations.literal: following the time of nurturing, especially from lenient statute.
translations.idiomatic: yet following the season of nurturing, leniency under statute is especially appropriate.

sentences.zh: 勉宜省過，無或徇非。

translations.literal: Exert yourself to examine faults; do not follow wrong.
translations.idiomatic: Exert yourself to examine faults—do not follow wrong.

sentences.zh: 可建州刺史。」

translations.literal: May be prefect of Jianzhou."
translations.idiomatic: He may serve as prefect of Jianzhou."

sentences.zh: 未幾元稹用事，自郡召還，復為諫議大夫。

translations.literal: Before long Yuan Zhen held power; recalled from prefecture, again Remonstrance and Policy Advisor.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Yuan Zhen held power; recalled from prefecture, again remonstrance and policy advisor.

sentences.zh: 其年十二月，景儉朝退，與兵部郎中知制誥馮宿、庫部郎中知制誥楊嗣復、起居舍人溫造、司勛員外郎李肇、刑部員外郎王鎰等同謁史官獨孤朗，乃於史館飲酒。

translations.literal: That twelfth month Jingjian after court withdrew with Director of War and Drafting Commissioner Feng Su, Director of Stores and Drafting Commissioner Yang Sifu, Diarist Wen Zao, Director of Merits Li Zhao, Vice Director of Punishments Wang Yi together visited Historiographer Dugu Lang, then drank in the Historiography Office.
translations.idiomatic: That twelfth month Jingjian after court withdrew with director of war and drafting commissioner Feng Su, director of stores and drafting commissioner Yang Sifu, diarist Wen Zao, director of merits Li Zhao, vice director of punishments Wang Yi together visited historiographer Dugu Lang, then drank in the historiography office.

sentences.zh: 景儉乘醉詣中書謁宰相，呼王播、崔植、杜元穎名，面疏其失，辭頗悖慢。

translations.literal: Jingjian drunk went to the Secretariat to visit chief ministers, calling Wang Bo, Cui Zhi, and Du Yuanying by name, face to face stating their faults, words quite rude.
translations.idiomatic: Jingjian drunk went to the Secretariat to visit chief ministers, calling Wang Bo, Cui Zhi, and Du Yuanying by name, face to face stating their faults—words quite rude.

sentences.zh: 宰相遜言止之，旋奏貶漳州刺史。

translations.literal: Chief ministers with modest words stopped him; soon memorialized demotion to prefect of Zhangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Chief ministers with modest words stopped him—soon memorialized demotion to prefect of Zhangzhou.

sentences.zh: 是日同飲於史館者皆貶逐。

translations.literal: That day those who drank in the Historiography Office were all demoted and driven.
translations.idiomatic: That day those who drank in the historiography office were all demoted and driven.

sentences.zh: 景儉未至漳州而元稹作相，改授楚州刺史。

translations.literal: Jingjian had not reached Zhangzhou when Yuan Zhen became chief minister; changed to prefect of Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Jingjian had not reached Zhangzhou when Yuan Zhen became chief minister—changed to prefect of Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 議者以景儉使酒，淩忽宰臣，詔令才行，遽遷大郡。

translations.literal: Debaters held Jingjian used wine, insulted chief ministers; edict just issued, suddenly moved to great prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Debaters held Jingjian used wine, insulted chief ministers—edict just issued, suddenly moved to great prefecture.

sentences.zh: 稹懼其物議，追還，授少府少監。

translations.literal: Zhen feared public debate, recalled, made Vice Director of the Palace Domestic Works.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen feared public debate, recalled, made vice director of the palace domestic works.

sentences.zh: 從坐者皆召還。

translations.literal: Those who sat with him were all recalled.
translations.idiomatic: Such who sat with him were all recalled.

sentences.zh: 而景儉竟以忤物不得誌而卒。

translations.literal: Yet Jingjian ultimately for offending others did not achieve his will and died.
translations.idiomatic: And yet Jingjian ultimately for offending others did not achieve his will and died.

sentences.zh: 景儉疏財尚議，雖不厲名節，死之日，知名之士鹹惜之。

translations.literal: Jingjian was loose with wealth and valued debate; though not strict with integrity, on the day he died noted gentlemen all regretted him.
translations.idiomatic: Jingjian was loose with wealth and valued debate—though not strict with integrity, on the day he died noted gentlemen all regretted him.

sentences.zh: 景儉弟景儒、景信、景仁，皆有藝學，知名於時。

translations.literal: Jingjian's younger brothers Jingru, Jingxin, and Jingren all had artistic learning, noted in the time.
translations.idiomatic: Jingjian's younger brothers Jingru, Jingxin, and Jingren all had artistic learning—noted in the time.

sentences.zh: 景信、景仁，皆登進士第。

translations.literal: Jingxin and Jingren both passed civil examinations.
translations.idiomatic: Jingxin and Jingren both earned jinshi degrees.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：仲尼有言：「不得中行而與之，必也狂狷乎！」

translations.literal: The historian says: Confucius said: "If I cannot walk with the balanced, I must with the reckless and the principled!"
translations.idiomatic: The historian writes: Confucius said: "If I cannot walk with the balanced, I must with the reckless and the principled!"

sentences.zh: 若渤論考第，仲方駁謚，誠知後悔，不能息言，可謂狷歟？

translations.literal: If Bo discussed examination ranks and Zhongfang rebutted the posthumous title—knowing regret yet not ceasing speech—can this be called principled?
translations.idiomatic: When Bo debated examination ranks and Zhongfang rebutted a posthumous title—knowing regret yet refusing silence—can this be called principled?

sentences.zh: 當賊註挾邪之辰，群公結舌而寢默，而中敏、李甘、元裕，或肆其言，或奮其筆，暴揚醜跡，不憚撩須。

translations.literal: When the villain Zhu clutched evil, the grandees were tongue-tied and silent, while Zhongmin, Li Gan, and Yuanyu—some unleashed speech, some wielded the brush, exposing ugly tracks, not fearing to pull the beard.
translations.idiomatic: Once the villain Zhu clutched evil, the grandees were tongue-tied and silent, while Zhongmin, Li Gan, and Yuanyu—some unleashed speech, some wielded the brush, exposing ugly tracks, not fearing to pull the beard.

sentences.zh: 謂之為狂，即有遺恨，比夫請劍斷佞，亦可同年而語也。

translations.literal: To call them reckless leaves regret; compared to begging the sword to cut the flatterer, they can speak in the same year.
translations.idiomatic: To call them reckless leaves regret—compared to begging the sword to cut the flatterer, they can speak in the same year.

sentences.zh: 南紀有良史才，足以自立，而協比權幸，顛沛終身。

translations.literal: Nan Ji had good historian talent enough to stand alone, yet joined the powerful and stumbled all life.
translations.idiomatic: Nan Ji had good historian talent enough to stand alone—yet joined the powerful and stumbled all life.

sentences.zh: 君子慎獨，庸可忽諸。

translations.literal: The gentleman is cautious alone—how can it be neglected?
translations.idiomatic: The gentleman is cautious even when alone—how can such a thing be neglected?

sentences.zh: 景儉自負太過，蕩而無檢，良驥中年跅弛之患也。

translations.literal: Jingjian's self-confidence was excessive, dissolute without restraint—the fine steed's midlife laxity affliction.
translations.idiomatic: Jingjian's self-confidence ran too far; dissolute and unrestrained, he suffered the fine steed's midlife lapse.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：張、李切言，利刃決云。

translations.literal: The encomium says: Zhang and Li cut speech, sharp blade deciding cloud.
translations.idiomatic: The encomium says: Zhang and Li cut speech—sharp blade deciding cloud.

sentences.zh: 裴諫方士，深誠愛君。

translations.literal: Pei remonstrated formula masters, deep sincerity loving the lord.
translations.idiomatic: Pei remonstrated against formula masters with deep sincerity and love for his lord.

sentences.zh: 言排賊註，高、李不群。

translations.literal: In speech they denounced the villain Zhu; Gao and Li kept apart from the herd.
translations.idiomatic: They spoke out against the villain Zheng Zhu; Gao and Li would not herd with the corrupt.

sentences.zh: 漢、儉朋比，夫何足云。

translations.literal: Han and Jingjian formed cliques and alliances; what is there worth saying?
translations.idiomatic: Li Han and Li Jingjian trafficked in faction—scarcely worth a word.
